title: A Station You Can Ship: A Link, a Watchdog, an Enable Switch, Commands That Are Retried and a Shutdown That Is in Order
fallback: This lesson wires together everything this phase says about a station that talks to a robot, so it needs Qt Network. Lesson 12-03 is the retrying of commands and lesson 07-16 the measuring of a loop, in plain C++. Without Qt, do those and come back when Qt is installed.

artifact.note: a control station of a link that reconnects, a watchdog on the robot, an enable switch, commands that are retried and applied once, and a shutdown in order, wired together
